answer: Each agent identity must lock a minimum bond for a full epoch before its attestations count, so capital cannot be recycled into another fake account. Every wallet one operator controls merges into one balance-capped weight, so a thousand keys still act as a single actor. Cost scales linearly: N identities need N locked stakes and N slashing exposures, so the marginal sybil is unprofitable. Honest stake is a glacier, slow to build; fraud burns it to zero. Votes refract through a prism weighted by bond age, not per address, and markets forge reputation once and keep it.
